Mary J. Blige shocked the internet when she mentioned in an interview that she wasn’t a fan of her McDonald’s commercial and ultimately received some backlash after it aired! Tap in with @lorenlorosa for the latest as she breaks down why Mary felt it was a bad move for her.

🚨 @tyrese came through to promote his upcoming show at UBS Arena on 4/18 and dives into what happened behind the scenes with Tank at Verzuz and why he was shocked by the level he took it to. Check out the full conversation on @netflix!

Drake’s new album 'ICEMAN' might be on the way, based on an explosion in Toronto. Fans started connecting the dots after reports of a blast during a controlled “movie shoot” that Drake also reposted… @lorenlorosa breaks it down on the latest.

Our sincerest condolences go out to the families. Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC.

Video

🚨Norega opens up about the fallouts with Ye, Stephen Jackson, Offset and Sweetie behind what was and wasn't aired on Drink Champs. 🤔 Who would've thought .... Diddy would be the voice of reason for one of these beefs. Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa !

Video

🚨 This season of *RHOA*, Marlo Hampton didn’t get her 🍑, and after interviews where she made it clear where she stands with some of the ladies, she also shared her feelings about Porsha. @porsha4real responds to Marlo’s claims that she’s a hater and stopped her bag! Check out the full interview on @netflix!

Video

Donkey of the Day goes to a man who broke into a building and was caught in the bathroom because he had to poop 💩🚽 so badly that he told the police he was having a “bowel crisis”… sir, what did you eat 🫣???Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC.

Video

🚨 @repilhan breaks down why she extends grace to former Trump supporters who have changed their views on Trump’s policies. She gives grace to Taylor Greene but won’t be kicking it with her anytime soon. Check out the full conversation on @netflix

Video

Body cam footage has been released of King Harris’ arrest, and it shows T.I.P. arriving at the scene, hoping to bring him home. Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.
